pre_reveal_change.candidate_space: restrict each site to WT plus non-WT residue states having a measured visible single-mutant outcome
pre_reveal_change.pair_terms: use measured visible double residuals only; absent double terms contribute zero and pair-coverage is audited

rationale: The frozen B1/B2/B3/B6 formulas require a visible single effect for every mutated state. Restricting to states with measured singles is a data-availability repair, not outcome tuning.
trigger: The public PhoQ table contains only 69 of the 76 possible non-WT single substitutions.
